# Real key photos for the OCR hit-rate test

Drop photos of real keys here; `e2e/ocr.spec.ts` runs each through the same pipeline as the
Scan screen and reports the hit rate.

- Name each file `<NUMBER>__<anything>.jpg|png`, e.g. `KF-1021__brass-front.jpg`.
- Crop roughly to the stamped area (like the on-screen guide box).
- Don't commit photos that show your address or anything identifying.

Phase 9 acceptance: ≥ 70% exact or top-3 hits on these photos.
